rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for one of four equal parts.

example.english: This slice of cake is a quarter of the whole cake.
example.traditional: 呢份蛋糕係成個蛋糕嘅四分一。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 daan6 gou1 hai6 seng4 go3 daan6 gou1 ge3 sei3 fan1 jat1

rows.note: Use this for a fifteen-minute period, especially when telling the time.

example.english: The meeting will start in a quarter.
example.traditional: 而家差唔多一個字就開會喇。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 caa1 m4 do1 jat1 go3 zi6 zau6 hoi1 wui2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a three-month division of a year, especially in business or official contexts.

example.english: The company's results for the second quarter were better than expected.
example.traditional: 公司第二季度嘅業績好過預期。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 dai6 ji6 gwai3 dou6 ge3 jip6 zik1 hou2 gwo3 jyu6 kei4

rows.note: Use this for one of the four periods of a sports game.

example.english: We won a quarter but still lost the game.
example.traditional: 我哋贏咗一節，但最後都輸波。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jeng4 zo2 jat1 zit3 daan6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 syu1 bo1
